name: Invoices and Receipts
trigger: You want professional documents sent the moment something is paid or owed.
summary: Invoice numbering must be gapless and sequential per legal entity. This is a common audit finding and is worth getting right in the capability rather than per client — the sequence is allocated inside the insert transaction, so a rolled-back invoice does not burn a number and two concurrent inserts cannot share one.

requires.reason: Line totals, tax, and balances are Money.
An invoice is rendered to a PDF through the template engine, so branding stays consistent with the product.

enhances.unlocks: a renewal issues an invoice automatically
milestones bill as invoices against a schedule
calculated tax appears as invoice lines
invoices post to the accounting system with an external reference retained
invoices and receipts are delivered and their opens tracked

privacy.retention_note: Financial record. Anonymised rather than deleted so the sequence stays gapless and the ledger reconciles.

owns.name: CreditNote
owns.description: Corrections are credit notes, never edits to an issued invoice.

owns.name: InvoiceSequence
owns.description: Per-legal-entity counter. Allocated inside the invoice insert transaction, which is what makes numbering gapless under concurrency.

consumes.name: payment.succeeded
consumes.reason: mark the matching invoice paid and issue a receipt

consumes.name: payment.refunded
consumes.reason: issue a credit note against the original invoice

consumes.name: milestone.due
consumes.reason: issue an invoice for a due milestone when pay.deposits is present

consumes.name: order.placed
consumes.reason: issue an invoice for a placed order when commerce.catalog is present

exposes.name: issue
exposes.description: Agent-callable with approval: issuing an invoice is an outbound communication with financial meaning.

surfaces.name: InvoicePdf
surfaces.description: Rendered through docs.generation so it carries the client's kernel.ui tokens.

numbering_scheme.description: Tokens: {YYYY}, {YY}, {MM}, {SEQ:n}. Must contain {SEQ:n} or validation fails, because a scheme without a sequence cannot be gapless.

slots.name: numberingScheme
slots.when: when an invoice number is allocated
slots.description: Client-specific numbering beyond the configured token scheme. Must remain gapless per legal entity; the generated contract test asserts it.

slots.name: lineItemFormatting
slots.description: Client-specific line descriptions, grouping, and ordering.

slots.name: paymentTerms
slots.when: when an invoice due date is computed
slots.description: Client-specific terms, such as per-customer net days.

smoke.name: invoice issues and renders
smoke.asserts: issuing an invoice produces a numbered record and a rendered PDF

smoke.name: numbering is gapless under concurrency
smoke.asserts: 100 concurrent issues produce 100 consecutive numbers with no gaps and no duplicates

smoke.name: a rolled-back insert does not burn a number
smoke.asserts: a failed invoice insert leaves the sequence unchanged

contract.scenario: a payment succeeds against an open invoice
contract.asserts: the invoice is marked paid, a receipt is issued, and a redelivered payment.succeeded does not double-apply

contract.scenario: an invoice is rendered after its template is updated
contract.asserts: the rendering uses the template version pinned at issue time, so a reissued historical invoice is byte-identical
